message.content: {"note_claim": "NATO Article 5 applies only to armed attacks on member territory in Europe or North America, or specified North Atlantic areas north of the Tropic of Cancer, and does not apply to bases in the UAE.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "For the purpose of Article 5, an armed attack on one or more of the Parties is deemed to include an armed attack: on the territory of any of the Parties in Europe or North America", "reason": "Article 6 of the North Atlantic Treaty explicitly limits Article 5's geographic scope to Europe, North America, and North Atlantic areas north of the Tropic of Cancer, which excludes the UAE."}

parsed.note_claim: NATO Article 5 applies only to armed attacks on member territory in Europe or North America, or specified North Atlantic areas north of the Tropic of Cancer, and does not apply to bases in the UAE.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: For the purpose of Article 5, an armed attack on one or more of the Parties is deemed to include an armed attack: on the territory of any of the Parties in Europe or North America
parsed.reason: Article 6 of the North Atlantic Treaty explicitly limits Article 5's geographic scope to Europe, North America, and North Atlantic areas north of the Tropic of Cancer, which excludes the UAE.
